## Checklist
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/GND-0/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and my commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] CI passes locally (`make lint sim` for hardware, or `pnpm lint` for the website)
- [ ] I updated docs/README for anything user-facing
- [ ] **No secrets, `.env` files, proprietary PDK/library files, licensed tool files or NDA material** are included
- [ ] Generated files (waveforms, `runs/`, build output) are not committed
